title: Reintentar verificación V18 Notas/login en browser representativo
mission: Re-run the V18 Notas/date and generic-login verification only in a runtime with a representative JavaScript browser. Verify desktop and narrow/mobile behavior and runtime errors from the live/candidate surface; preserve the honest disabled generic-login boundary and do not infer Human Accepted, Current or Served.
definition_of_done: Representative JavaScript browser evidence exists for desktop and narrow/mobile widths.
Notas/date shows only real legacy rows or honest loading/error/empty states; no synthetic class/date placeholders are accepted.
Generic login remains visibly disabled/capability-honest and does not masquerade as Blackboard login.
Version anterior remains usable and runtime errors are recorded.
No Human Accepted, Current or Served promotion is inferred.
